Median rent of VIC by local government area of each quarter

vic_rents.Rd

Median rent of VIC by local government area of each quarter

Usage

vic_rents

Format

A data frame with 58618 rows and 6 column

quarter

First day of each quarter with median rent

property_type

Property type of the property from 1 bedroom to 4 bedroom house and all properties

lga

Local government area

region

Departmental region the area belongs to

Median

Median weekly rent in Australian dollars

Count

Number of new lettings the median is based on

Source

Homes Victoria, Rental Report - Quarterly: Quarterly Median Rents by LGA, September quarter 2025. Licensed CC BY 3.0 AU. https://data.gov.au/data/dataset/rental-report-quarterly-quarterly-median-rents-by-lga

Details

Median only cover the new rental price but not all property resources. Homes Victoria will hide the data and show in NA if the quarter record only have too few trades.
